purpose: Primary camera menu sources for one owner-coordinated AF4.1 MF capture/shutdown cycle; no camera outcome inferred.

sources.title: Sony ILCE-7CM2 Help Guide: Selecting the focus method (Focus Mode)
sources.authoredSummary: Focus mode is selected through the Focus / AF-MF menu independently of exposure mode. Manual Focus is the requested initial test setting; DMF includes autofocus and is a separate choice.

sources.title: Sony ILCE-7CM2 Help Guide: Pre-AF
sources.authoredSummary: Pre-AF controls automatic focusing before a half-press. The test requests Off if the setting is available.
